rules.source: Approved Workbench v11.5 §5.1–5.3 and final user clarification that the shared auxiliary catalog must not store or show suppliers; order suppliers only come from the current supplier master.
rules.rule: Store supplier-independent catalog items, search all authorized pages by material fields, and retire new merges at the HTTP boundary without destroying historical aliases, versions or receipts.
rules.initialization: No new migration or existing-data rewrite. New rows store no supplier in the existing column. Keep decoding old replay envelopes and redact the legacy supplier field on the receipt response.
rules.dateAndPermission: Read/write/price authorization and locks remain existing per role and identity, including revoked identities and verified Root; no supplier-master write authority or restored merge/enable action.
rules.expectation: Duplicate registration, unauthorized access and hand-entered supplier are rejected. Old names still find the current allowed material and old merges and receipts remain readable, with no supplier search or projection.

rules.source: Approved Workbench v11.5 §5.1–5.3 and final user clarification that the shared auxiliary catalog must not store or show suppliers; order suppliers only come from the current supplier master.
rules.rule: Use the existing catalog page and original selection dialog; present reference price, true version and stable actions without supplier text and preserve paging, recovery and layout.
rules.initialization: Keep original route, default immediate list, page size, exact historical reads and foreground controls. Existing price vs zero vs unknown stays separately represented.
rules.dateAndPermission: Price and write controls reflect the original service authorization. Unauthorized clerk and PMC are denied, while the original roles use their own independent directory.
rules.expectation: Repeat app actions through real signed sessions to prove scrolling and action alignment, correct filtered pagination, no stale Enter request, persistence and retry of a lost response, immutable exact history and no new merge control.

rules.source: Approved Workbench v11.5 §5.1–5.3 and final user clarification that the shared auxiliary catalog must not store or show suppliers; order suppliers only come from the current supplier master.
rules.rule: Order supplier selection and catalog price adoption remain independent. Copy only the allowed material facts, exact reference/version and reference price; editing this order never updates the shared directory.
rules.initialization: Use existing current/saved versions. Old orders retain the exact original order supplier and adopted price; neither directory renames nor order changes mutate saved history.
rules.dateAndPermission: The signed ordinary designer selects an eligible supplier using the existing C2 endpoint, without sourcing master permissions. Exact auxiliary snapshot identity is evaluated separately and never bypasses that order check.
rules.expectation: Numbered C2 draft saves and reopens both independent references and its edited order price. Free-form order supplier and invented/retired auxiliary versions are rejected without a record change. Existing development, clerk, quotation and material history consumers still work.
